note: §8.2.3 — "~53.4% of expected turnout" implied an unstated turnout of ~374,500 (70.3% of the register). §1.3.1 states a 62.0% participation baseline giving ~330,310 ballots, against which 200,000 is 60.5%. Recomputed from the document's own figures, with the baseline now named.
before: 2.  **The General Election Victory Threshold:** Securing **≥ 200,000 verified, counted votes** (representing ~53.4% of expected turnout across Kitui's 532,758 registered voters).
after: 2.  **The General Election Victory Threshold:** Securing **≥ 200,000 verified, counted votes** — approximately **60.5%** of the ~330,310 ballots expected at the county's 62.0% participation baseline against 532,758 registered voters (Section 1.3.1).

note: §8.2.3 — the nomination threshold restated as NW-01 states it: "≥ 55.0%" rather than ">55%", and the universe named as sampled likely Wiper primary voters. "Delegate" is dropped because §1.1 reports selection by opinion poll, with no delegate contest to organise. No figure changes.
before: 1.  **The Nomination Window Threshold:** Achieving >55% Wiper Party primary delegate/voter preference share.
after: 1.  **The Nomination Window Threshold:** Achieving **≥ 55.0%** first-choice preference among sampled likely Wiper primary voters (NW-01).
